notes.title: Update 0.4 - The Garrison District
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work with the first major content expansion to Monstrous Liberation, and we're ready to show it off! Meet new monsters to woo, unlock new sizzling hot scenes, unravel more of the story!

On top of new content, we also have some big improvements to existing content, such as updated background art and new music tracks! We hope you guys enjoy what we have in store for you!



Changelog 0.4:

50,000 words added to the script (total script wordcount now over 110k),

players can now explore the Garrison District of Civitas Imperito,

new character: Regla Shatterskull, orc warmistress,

new character: Shrill, harpy watch officer,

new character: Willowswitch, elven blacksmith with a big secret,

all fantasy world backgrounds are now hand-drawn,

over a dozen new music tracks,

six new full-length sex scenes,

more mini-scenes at the Hideout,

Gallery has been updated so that players can choose between watching full scenes or only viewing that scene's art,

various small art & text fixes
